candidates.name: Search for land and property information
verified_facts: The service provides property summaries, title registers and title plans for registered property in England and Wales.
The title plan provides location and general-boundary information, while official copies are separately required for proof of ownership.
semantic_limits: Search-service availability and title-plan access do not provide an exact surveyed boundary, terrain elevation or vertical-accuracy budget.

candidates.name: Practice Guide 10: official search of the index map
verified_facts: HM Land Registry explains that index-map searches identify registered titles affecting a searched area.
Illustrative plans associated with index-map results are for illustration and do not define the extent of an individual registered title.
semantic_limits: An index-map search result or illustrative plan cannot be substituted for exact parcel geometry or numeric elevation evidence.
